description: ⚡ Copper Golems now strike back with deadly lightning when attacked.

mods.name: Copper Golem Retribution
mods.description: Makes Copper Golems retaliate with devastating lightning when attacked.

releases.notes: ## ⚡ Copper Golem Retribution v1.0.0 The Copper Golem is no longer harmless. This release introduces a powerful defensive mechanic that punishes players who attack Copper Golems with devastating lightning strikes. --- ### ✨ Features - Passive → aggressive Copper Golem behavior - Targets only the player who attacks it - Summons multiple lightning strikes on the attacker ⚡ - High-damage retaliation system --- ### ⏱️ Mechanics - Built-in cooldown system to prevent ability spam - Optional staggered lightning strikes for cinematic effect --- ### 🧩 Configuration - Auto-generated config file - Fully customizable: - Lightning strike count - Damage values - Cooldown duration --- ### ⚙️ Compatibility - Minecraft 1.21.11 - Fabric Loader - Fabric API --- ### ⚠️ Notes - Copper Golem must exist (modded/custom entity if not in vanilla) - This mod is server-side required --- ### 💡 Future Plans - Charging animation before lightning - Improved particle & sound effects - Oxidation-based strength scaling --- 🔥 First release — feedback is welcome!
